normalization.D: weighted passed deterministic subtest weight / total fixed deterministic weight
normalization.S: weighted mean of applicable 0-4 criterion levels / 4
normalization.not_applicable: exclude from the semantic denominator only when both judgments mark the criterion NOT_APPLICABLE

precedence: RETRY_ERROR when infrastructure is unavailable or the run is inconclusive
POLICY_FAILURE when an enforced security policy is violated
FAIL_INVARIANT when any mandatory exercise gate fails
REVIEW when judge output is invalid, abstained, conflicting, borderline, or evidence-conflicting
PASS or FAIL only after the preceding gates pass

judge_protocol.development_baseline: two independent judge calls; preserve both raw outputs
judge_protocol.adaptive_comparison: one initial call, second call only for predeclared ambiguous/invalid/conflicting cases
judge_protocol.correlation_warning: judge agreement is not correctness evidence; automatic error must be measured against adjudicated labels

dataset_target.split_unit: submission family; no family may cross calibration and held-out sets
dataset_target.labels: two independent human ratings retained unchanged, plus separate adjudicated label
dataset_target.status: not yet collected; do not fabricate labels or split assignments

metrics.uncertainty: 95% bootstrap confidence interval over submission-level outcomes
required: false_acceptance_rate = incorrect automatic PASS / all incorrect labelled submissions
false_rejection_rate = incorrect automatic FAIL / all correct labelled submissions
semantic_mae = mean absolute level error over applicable criteria
automatic_coverage = automatic final decisions / all submissions
review_rate = human review decisions / all submissions
metrics.denominator_rule: report numerator and denominator for every rate; exclude infrastructure RETRY_ERROR only when separately reported

local_judge_feasibility.minimum: one real exercise, one real local model, recorded cold/warm time, peak memory, JSON validity, model/runtime/quantization
local_judge_feasibility.capacity_reservation: judge memory is reserved separately from execution workers
local_judge_feasibility.mock_judge: integration-only; not evidence of M7 completion
